scope: Five previous compact S01 packages plus 25 subsequent S01/event initialization, control and root-reference packages; complete field metadata, no model/template/image payload. Four 2026-11-04 source-support and own-initial-reference spin comparison parameter archives; no raw ExMR animation/model/surface/image payload. Added 2026-11-04 grasp, support-foot, continuous entry and mass-weighted gravity initial/control parameters; original failed candidates remain retained. Added 2026-11-05 absolute continuous v1/v2 control/initialization candidates, explicit SU(2) edge-chart references and local leg-association repair; no complete surface, model weights or source image payload. Added 2026-11-05 boot-contour/axis and conditional runner-support bounded candidates; existing absolute controls and frozen identity, no new shoe DOF or full surface/model/image payload. Added bounded runner-interior/mode failures and whole-S05 body/relative-skate curves, full-source boundary plus camera-conditioned XY fitting controls; no complete body surfaces/model weights/image payload. Added 2026-11-06 whole-S05 source-fusion and native support/pixel-profile candidates, including failed retained parameters; shared camera/template fixed, no model weights, full surfaces or source image buffers.
